name: Media Hub (Preview)
overview: In-process media and Discord integration for Jellyfin 12. Preview; not production-ready.
description: Media Hub runs inside Jellyfin with an integrated, restartable setup tutorial. It provides verified account linking, scoped movie/TV discovery and confirmed requests, native libraries, personal watchlists and Seerr reconciliation, selected music/book requests, notifications, operator messaging and a bundled optional Discord Activity. Shared deletion requires requester ownership, current viewer consent, a full delay and approved Arr destinations; automatic removal defaults off. SyncPlay invitations remain blocked without exact creator-session proof. Feature completion and live provider/client acceptance remain outstanding.
